# semaphore_ex_project_notification_routing_preview (Action)

Evaluates notification routing without sending a notification. Executes only through explicit Action invocation. Progress reports a bounded, non-secret summary. Full preview results are available through the matching ephemeral resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "semaphore_ex_project_notification_routing_preview" "example" {
  config {
    project_id = 1
    event = {
      source_revision  = 1
      source           = { kind = "task", id = "task:12" }
      lifecycle_id     = "template:7"
      severity         = "error"
      lifecycle_action = "trigger"
      details          = { task_id = 12, template_id = 7, status = "failed" }
    }
  }
}

# terraform apply -invoke=action.semaphore_ex_project_notification_routing_preview.example
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event` (Dynamic) Native NotificationEvent object. Scope and project identity are derived from this operation and cannot be changed by the event.
- `project_id` (Number)
